scoring: content_risk_score = round(P(phishing) * 100); spam is NOT a threat; URLs stripped before tokenization (SVC-03 scores them).

calibration.note: Temperature fitted on val logits; threshold tuned for recall at min FPR. content_risk_score is threshold-independent (it is P(phishing)*100).

held_out_real_phishing.source: Nazario + Nigerian-419, held out of training (15%)
held_out_real_phishing.note: Honest out-of-distribution generalization number. v1 scored ~0.008 here (catastrophic corpus-overfit); v2 lifted it to 0.87 by moving real messy phishing into training and capping any single corpus.

deployability_gate.covers: simple/obvious sanity (hi/ok/thanks must score 0) + every FP class (terse, marketing, security-notice, transactional, incident, real Enron corporate, OTP, calendar, shared-doc, meta-phish) + every FN class (BEC/giftcard/payroll/wire, credential, TOAD, quishing, MFA-fatigue, OAuth, brand, extortion, crypto, classic scams, soft/calm-framed, notification-lure, calm-secret-reveal).

adversarial_robustness.harness: scratch_build/metamorphic_robustness.py (invariant/metamorphic: a semantics-preserving transform of caught phishing must not evade)
adversarial_robustness.defense_split: char/encoding attacks canonicalized at preprocessing (confusables fold, leet fold, de-spacing, zero-width strip); typo/leet-bomb robustness from char-noise + leet augmentation + FGM in training.

novel_unseen_probe.description: Fresh wording never in training/gate/red-team: 8 phishing + 6 legit
novel_unseen_probe.note: Flawless on genuinely unseen phrasing — caught payroll-redirect, e-sign-cred, seed-phrase, quishing, TOAD, romance-scam at 99-100; all legit at 0.

battery_1.residual_soft_fn: A few calm/ambiguous business lures (M&A priming, soft-delivery whose payload was the stripped URL, benefits-lock) remain low. These are the architecture-aware boundary: their disambiguating signal is the URL/sender (SVC-03/04), not the text. The same classes in non-cue-stripped phrasing ARE caught.

quantization_evaluation.summary: fp32 shipped for score integrity. Dynamic INT8 is a measured size/latency option with borderline-case jitter; static INT8 is unusable.

dynamic_int8.confident_cases: identical (delta content_risk_score = 0; clear phish=100, legit=0 unchanged)
dynamic_int8.borderline_cases: max |delta crs| = 77 across gate cases; 2/54 classification flips in the red-team pool, concentrated on the soft/ambiguous class (calm-secret, soft-delivery, benefits-lock)
dynamic_int8.batteries: metamorphic all held; red-team battery-2 0/0; novel probe 0 FN / 0 FP; zero false positives
dynamic_int8.verdict: optional — acceptable only if the deployment tolerates crs jitter on cases already deferred to SVC-03/04

static_int8_qdq.result: REJECTED — max |delta crs| = 100; confident phishing (100) collapses to 0-14 on 28/48 cases

pareto_frontier.claim: Cycle-12 is the best attainable point on the TEXT-ONLY Pareto frontier for this task.
pareto_frontier.evidence: Cycles 10-13 oscillate on the soft/calm business-phishing boundary; gains in recall there cost an equal amount of legit precision, because the disambiguating signal (URL/sender) is intentionally removed and scored by SVC-03/04. Cycle-12 sits at the best point: gate PASS, 0 FP everywhere, adversarial battery fully held, novel probe flawless, best real-recall.
